chapters.label: The final
chapters.text: Munich, 2025: the Champions League final. Paris captain Marquinhos faces Inter. Here’s how he defends. Inter look for their striker… but Marquinhos steps in first!

chapters.label: The replay
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Marquinhos watches the passer’s eyes. He sees where the pass is going, so he moves early… and steps in front of the striker!

chapters.label: Ball stolen
chapters.text: Ball stolen! Marquinhos lifts his head and starts the attack with a pass. Paris won five–nil, their first Champions League!

chapters.label: The lesson
chapters.text: That’s Marquinhos. Watch the passer’s eyes, and step in front of the striker to steal it!
